Riot Games support: Walking, Running and Crouching
sources.note: Official description of the modes; gives no speeds.

infantry.note: Knife out, 6.75 m/s. run = 6.75 m/s x the weapon's runSpeedMultiplier from the game data (matches the run speeds the in-game Arsenal shows: 5.73, 5.4, 5.13, 5.06 m/s). walk (x0.55) and crouch (x0.4) are estimates: Riot does not publish them. No sprint, no prone.
